title: Term Alignment Reduction — Residential Natural Gas Supply Added Premises
content:
**Clause.** For a premise added to a Residential Natural Gas Supply household, the term alignment reduction depends on the calendar days from the enrollment date to the home agreement's contract end date: 0.0050 per therm when they are 540 or more, 0.0025 per therm when they are at least 180 but fewer than 540, and none when they are fewer than 180 or the home agreement carries no contract end date. The reduction lowers the household rate by that amount per therm.

The record read is the contract end date on the home agreement.

| Home agreement's contract end date | Calendar days from the enrollment date to it | Reduction per therm |
|---|---|---|
| present | 540 or more | 0.0050 |
| present | 180 to 539 | 0.0025 |
| present | fewer than 180 | none |
| absent (no contract end date) | — | none |

### Edges (hypothetical spans)

540 days earns 0.0050 and 539 days earns 0.0025; 180 days earns 0.0025 and 179 days earns none. A home agreement on month-to-month service, which carries no contract end date, earns none.
